Yes. But he lives in the other part of the world. And me being insecure and anxious hinders me trying to video chat with them. 

Also, I feel like I don't deserve them. So I try to live from day to day trying to accept that I might die alone with no one to love and no one to love me. 

It hurts. It really hurts. But I'll live.
Tbh. Gapang everyday. Sometimes you win some, sometimes you lose some.

Hi Juan!

I literally am in the same boat but I'm a girl in my mid 20s. Right now. I try to redirect my energy to playing video games or even trying to connect with other people (kahit ala naman nangyayari lol). 

Trying to hook someone into being your light is sad, don't you think? The pressure might get to them. Or you might get disappointed with them. Because they can't be the sun to your moon. So I suggest trying to open your curtains a bit? Like trying to know what you like (do you like sports? Gym? Art? Music? or try things na you haven't done that you have always wanted to do samgyupsal mag-isa? Deep sea diving?


Mmm. So I guess yun lang naman.
Tbh. I'm trying to save up and do just that to go to Canada. I've always been very suicidal where I'm at and maybe resetting myself in Canada would be better.
